title: Corgi Dog Tags for Short Legs, Big Demands | Salty Dog Tags
description: Engraved tags for the dog built two inches off the ground. Laser cut in Lehi, Utah, with your corgi's name and number on the back. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for a big dog in a short dog's body. Corgis herd the kids, sploot on command and run the house from roughly ankle height. Our bulldogs are also low riders, so we relate.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for a tag that rides two inches off the ground
tough.html:
A corgi's tag is closer to the ground than any other breed's except a dachshund's. It drags through grass, sand and puddles all day, and gets the full sploot treatment on every cool floor.

Our text is laser-cut into the metal, so scuffing doesn't take your phone number with it. No paint to chip, nothing to peel.

Low to the ground. High on readability.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Corgis and bulldogs share a love of floors and a dislike of stairs. The corgi lines come from friends whose corgis herd our bulldogs, who refuse to be herded.

sayings.h2: 8 corgi sayings for short legs and big egos
sayings.lead: Front of the tag. About the legs, the herding, the sploots and the royal attitude. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will grass, sand and puddles wear off the engraving?
items.a: No. The text is laser engraved into the metal, so ground-level scuffing doesn't erase it.

items.q: Can I put my corgi's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes. Saying on the front, name and phone number on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for corgis?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the legs, the herding and the sploots. Each fits the tag as written.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.

product.description: Laser-engraved corgi dog ID tag: a funny saying on the front, your dog's name and phone number on the back. Anodized aluminum, stainless steel or brass.
